sources.snippet: XLS-R is a set of large-scale models for self-supervised cross-lingual speech representation learning based on wav2vec 2.0. It was pretrained on 128 languages and approximately 436K hours of unlabeled speech data. sources.snippet: wav2vec2-xls-r-300m implements the wav2vec 2.0 self-supervised learning architecture scaled to 300 million parameters. The model undergoes pretraining on 436,000 hours of public unlabeled speech across 128 languages.
